info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Support Tickets Closes-v3-spec
info.description: The Support Ticket Closure Retrieval API empowers businesses to efficiently access and review a list of support tickets that have been closed. This endpoint is designed for support teams and management to track resolved issues, evaluate response times, and enhance service quality. By fetching detailed records of closed tickets, users can analyze trends and customer feedback for continuous improvement. Typical consumers include customer support analysts and quality assurance teams who require insights into the resolution process.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to close a specified ticket in the system. Ensure that you have the correct permissions to perform this action.

requestBody.description: A request to close a specific ticket. This operation requires the details of the ticket to be closed in JSON format.

204.description: Request completed successfully with no content returned.

ListSupportTicketsClosesRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for closing tickets using the specified GET operation.

ListSupportTicketsClosesResponse_204.title: Close Ticket Response

state.description: The current state of the ticket after the operation.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the operation.

audit.description: Information about the audit details related to the operation.

ListSupportTicketsClosesResponse_204.description: Response schema for the operation that closes a ticket.
